title: ELN — 'Reflections: 2026 NPT Review Conference'
snippet: Confidence in diplomacy itself appears to be eroding. Beyond formal statements and procedural debates, conversations throughout the conference reflected a deeper frustration about limitations of existing diplomatic processes, difficulty of sustaining strategic dialogue, and absence of political leadership at a time of profound geopolitical instability.
related_item: src-003 (2026-05-25: ACA/Gazette NGR NPT RevCon 전문가 평가)
tag_reason: 5/25 보고서에서 NPT RevCon 사후 평가를 종합적으로 다루었음. ELN 분석은 동일 맥락의 추가 출처이나, 핵심 논점('외교 신뢰 침식')은 Kimball '토대 균열'과 유사. 추가 출처로 기록하되 reported 처리.
